title: PoeTech Bounded Auto-Resume Queue (Approved-Work Queue) v1
description: A materialized, EXPLICIT list of greenlit tasks the cap-resume runner is allowed to continue after a vendor outage/cap resets. This is BOUNDED resume of already-approved work, NOT open-ended autonomy: an item the human did not set approved:true can never be eligible. The runner (scripts/cap-resume.mjs) reads this, runs only approved+pending items behind the three brakes, and writes status back (idempotent). No item = no-op. The live instance lives at state/approved-queue.json on the NAS (gitignored); this folder ships the schema + a worked example.

v.description: Queue contract version. Bump only on a breaking change.

items.description: The queued tasks. Empty array = nothing approved = the runner no-ops.

id.description: Stable unique id for this queued task (e.g. 'resume-darrells-study-001'). Used for dedupe, the per-task idempotency, and audit.

approved.description: THE greenlight gate. Only true is eligible. There is no default-true path: a missing or false value means the runner skips the item. Darrell (governor) sets this.

status.description: Lifecycle. Only 'pending' is eligible; the runner writes 'in_progress' then 'done'/'failed'. A 'done' item is never resumed twice (idempotency).

not_before.description: Optional UTC ISO-8601 floor: even when approved + the cap window is open, do not resume this item before this instant.

handoff.description: The resume payload — a full wake/handoff object (REUSED verbatim from the wake bridge: handoff/schema.json). Carries lane, the concrete approved task, work_type (vendor affinity), private (sovereignty gate), and the state_pointer so a cold session can pick up. The wake_at field inside is not used for cap-resume scheduling (the cap window + approved gate drive that); it may be omitted or left as a placeholder.

last_run_at.description: Set by the runner: UTC ISO-8601 of the last attempt.

last_note.description: Set by the runner: short outcome note (vendor/model/cost or error).
